NOW® Sleep is a combination of ingredients formulated to help you ease your mind and relax your body so you can drift naturally off into a restful sleep. NOW® Sleep uses Valerian and Hops, two herbs that have been traditionally used to promote a calm relaxed state and support rejuvenating sleep. GABA is a neurotransmitter normally produced in the brain, where its function is to ease nervous tension. NOW® Sleep thus relaxes the nervous system to help you enjoy a tranquil night and wake up refreshed and energized in the morning.
Suggested use
Take 1-2 capsules one hour before bedtime as needed.
Other ingredients
Maltodextrin (non-gmo), hypromellose (cellulose capsule), silicon dioxide and ascorbyl palmitate.
Not manufactured with wheat, gluten, soy, milk, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nut or sesame ingredients. Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.
Made and quality tested in the USA with globally sourced ingredients. 
Warnings
Do not drive or operate machinery after taking this product. The ingredients in this product may interact with alcohol, sedatives and tranquilizers. For adults only. Consult physician if pregnant/nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition. Keep out of reach of children.
Keep freshness packet in bottle until it is empty. Keep bottle tightly closed at all time in between usage. Natural color variation or darkening may occur in this product when exposed to air.
Store in a cool, dry place after opening.

Magnesium for sensitive GI tracts supports muscle, heart, and bone health; promotes relaxation.
Magnesium is one of the most important minerals the human body requires, yet almost half the US population doesn’t get the magnesium their bodies need. Magnesium activates enzymes that are essential in many functions of the body, and promotes the normal metabolism of fat, carbohydrates, and amino acids. It supports healthy teeth and maintains bone density. Magnesium also helps maintain blood pressure levels already in the normal range as well as helping to maintain normal mood and emotional well-being premenstrually and during the menstrual cycle.

Magnesium Glycinate + Malate combines two forms of magnesium, magnesium malate and magnesium glycinate, which are easily absorbed into the bloodstream and are gentler on the digestive tract than magnesium oxide or magnesium citrate. Magnesium malate is recommended for energy production, while magnesium glycinate is a gentle form that could be one of the best types for those who want to promote mental calm, relaxation and good quality sleep.
